title: Linear Polynomials and y = mx + c
summary: Slope and intercept, graphs of linear polynomials, and their zeros.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): Introduction to Linear Polynomials

objectives: I can find the slope and y-intercept of a line.
